high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the verified user "sydney_sweeney." The post was taken at Disney World, as indicated by the location tag. The photo features a person sitting against a blue wall, wearing a black sleeveless top and sunglasses. They have blonde hair and are holding a chocolate-covered cookie with a Mickey Mouse design in front of their mouth, appearing to take a bite. The person is accessorized with multiple necklaces, including one with a heart pendant.
